name: io.github.tonydzi/lambda-cloud-mcp
title: Lambda Cloud
description: Lambda Cloud GPU prices, availability and instances for AI agents. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: LAMBDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Lambda Cloud API key from https://cloud.lambda.ai/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: LAMBDA_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable launch, restart and terminate tools (these cost money)

environmentVariables.name: LAMBDA_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default https://cloud.lambda.ai)
